description: Defines the EmployeeWorkShift entity class for ORM mapping, representing the association between employees and their work shifts in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkShift
classes.description: Entity class representing the relationship between an employee and a work shift, mapped to the database table ohrm_employee_work_shift.

methods.name: getWorkShift
methods.description: Returns the associated WorkShift object for this employee work shift.

methods.name: setWorkShift
methods.description: Sets the WorkShift object for this employee work shift.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this work shift.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee object for this work shift.
